tickets.title: Address mortgage servicing and title update
tickets.text: Address the mortgage servicer’s post‑death requirements and coordinate the county recorder to update the title to reflect Sera Bramblequill as sole owner, noting the $214,000 balance at 3.25% interest and the $90,000 HELOC limit at Teacup Comet Bank.

tickets.text: Organize the Moonbadger Life claim packet for Sera Bramblequill’s $500,000 term policy and track the insurer’s documentation requirements to secure the death benefit.

tickets.title: Coordinate benefits enrollment support
tickets.text: Coordinate benefits enrollment support for Sera Bramblequill during an open enrollment or new employment benefits decision. Use placeholders for employer materials, plan options, and elections; do not record sensitive personal information beyond what is needed for planning. Review Sera Bramblequill’s Clockwork Clover Robotics benefits portal and update her health, life, disability, and beneficiary elections after her spouse’s death.

subTasks.title: Collect benefits materials
subTasks.text: Request the benefits guide, plan comparison, premium schedule, employer match details, HSA or FSA options, life and disability coverage options, and enrollment instructions.

subTasks.title: Review planning tradeoffs
subTasks.text: Evaluate the materials for retirement contribution opportunities, tax considerations, insurance gaps, HSA eligibility, cash-flow impact, and coordination with existing coverage.

subTasks.title: Prepare client decision summary
subTasks.text: Summarize key elections, unresolved questions, and any items the client should confirm with the employer or benefits administrator before submitting choices.

subTasks.title: Document final elections for planning file
subTasks.text: After the client confirms submission, record the selected benefits categories, planning assumptions, and follow-up items for future review.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up for employer benefits after loss of spouse is due 2025-09-24.
